list_files_with_extensions: list files in a directory filtered by specified file extensions like txt and md
read_txt_file: read a text file and return a list of stripped lines, optionally skipping empty lines
save_json_file: save a dictionary to a JSON file with numpy array serialization support
read_json_file: read a JSON file and return its contents as a dictionary
save_yaml_file: save a dictionary to a YAML file with sorted keys disabled
